description.value: The Amphitrite House Interpretive Centre is a single-storey, wheelchair-accessible tourism information office situated on Coast Guard Road at the western edge of Ucluelet, near the tip of the peninsula. It provides interpretive information for visitors to this dramatic stretch of Vancouver Island's outer coast. The building's location in the Coast Guard Road area places it close to the Amphitrite Point Lighthouse and the rugged Pacific shoreline.
